research.thaumicboots.blastcatch.stage_0:
The machine-builders have a module that swallows explosions and gives back lightning. Sewn into a meteor's boots, beside the groundline contacts, it does the same for you.

Most of a blast's force now runs into the boots as charge instead of into your bones. And a meteor's slam, landing, can spend that charge to burst harder still.

You find yourself almost hoping for a creeper.
research.thaumicboots.blastcatch.title: Blastcatch Boots
research.thaumicboots.briar.stage_0:
The sloth's curse binds; the rimebark's thorns hold. Combined, they make a pair of boots that refuse to let you fall.

When a drop would hurt you, briars burst from the soles and catch you, and everything near the landing is snared in them. Whatever strikes you in close quarters is pricked for its trouble.

The boots wear a little with every catch.
research.thaumicboots.briar.subtitle: Thorns That Hold
research.thaumicboots.briar.title: Briarcatch Boots
research.thaumicboots.core.stage_0:
In your studies, you have discovered something rather... peculiar. In this, you found that you were somehow able to equally combine different forms of magick energy to create something...

Unique.

A new form of energy, somehow greater than the sum of its original parts.

You wonder where else this could be applied.
research.thaumicboots.core.subtitle: A Thaumaturgist's Guide to Arcane Cobbling
research.thaumicboots.core.title: Thaumaturgic Shoemaking
research.thaumicboots.emt_core.stage_0:
Recently, a peer of yours discovered something... peculiar: a form of seemingly mundane energy similar to that of lightning.

Studying it, however, you were able to discover it wasn't quite as mundane as you thought at all!

Rather, this new "electricity" seems to have an intrinsic tie to the natural energies found in vis, and yet, somehow... different, artificial.
research.thaumicboots.emt_core.stage_1:
In this, you found that you were able to create a pair of boots that ran on this "electricity" rather than the innate, and even moreso you were able to overcharge and improve their designs further.

You wonder where else this new energy could be applied...
research.thaumicboots.emt_core.subtitle: The Thaumaturgic Applications of Artificial Magicks
research.thaumicboots.emt_core.title: Artificial Magicks
research.thaumicboots.emt_tainted_compat:
As you continued your studies of electricity, you noticed something interesting, like the traditional magical energies, electricity was likewise able to be combined into other energies. However, at one caveat: it doesn't exactly mix into the energy but rather, converts the natural into the artificial.

In your applications of this to void energy, you found that not only can they run on electricity, but likewise, they can both be overcharged by electricity AND boosted by enhanced void.

A rather interesting revelation...
The Application of Artificial Energy in Void Magicks
research.thaumicboots.explorations_compa:
In your studies of the stars, you had discovered two distinct forms of celestial energies, those being the energy of comets as well as the energy of meteors. However, after your discovery of the thaumic combinator, you began to wonder if there were a way to combine these two energy signals...

Lo and behold, there was! Two distinct methods actually, though the results are currently shockingly similar.

Perhaps there might be a way to enhance these further...
Your study of the sky and stars yielded, after intense research of these celestial bodies, you discovered what you call "comets" and "meteors."

In this, you discovered some magicks innate to the heavens, able to be infused into your boots.

And yet, you feel as if there were still more to discover...
With this understood, the combinations it opens up wait elsewhere in this book.
A Thaumaturgist's Guide to the Galaxy
research.thaumicboots.explorations_emt_c:
As you continued your studies of electricity, you noticed something interesting, like the traditional magical energies, electricity was likewise able to be combined into other energies. However, at one caveat: it doesn't exactly mix into the energy but rather, converts the natural into the artificial.

In your applications of this to the celestial energies, you found that they were able to run on electricity, even being able to be overcharged, enhancing their natural tendencies.

A rather interesting revelation...
The Application of Artificial Energy in Celestial Magicks
research.thaumicboots.explorations_taint:
Studying the void, you have made a unique discovery: the void has celestial bodies itself.

A quite peculiar revelation at that. You began to wonder if it contained a similar magical energy like those of the mundane plane and found something miraculous! Similar to their counterparts, the void's bodies likewise contain innate magical properties; with one small caveat: they can't be tapped into directly.

However, by combining the energies of the void with the energies of the cosmic, you were able to make two more combined sets of boots, and continue to wonder if there may be more possibility than you thought?
Discovering Celestial Bodies of the Void
research.thaumicboots.framewalker.stage_:
A Grand Frame is a hollow made of walls that are not quite walls: casings that only pretend to be solid so long as the core believes in them.

The voidwalker's boots, it turns out, can be taught to disbelieve. Crouch, face such a wall, and jump: you step through the frame, the glass, the tube, as far as four blocks, and out the other side.

Stone, however, remains stone.
research.thaumicboots.framewalker.title: Framewalker's Boots
research.thaumicboots.grim.stage_0:
The Crimson Cult's boots were made for marching. Tempered in liquid death, they are made for landing.

Drop onto a living thing from any height and it takes the fall in your place, withering as it does; you rebound from it unhurt. The boots pay for each landing in wear rather than your bones.

The cultists would approve, you suspect.
research.thaumicboots.grim.subtitle: Liquid Death, Underfoot
research.thaumicboots.grim.title: Boots of the Grim Stomp
research.thaumicboots.groundline.stage_0:
The galvanic boots of the machine-builders drink from cells you carry. You wondered why they should not drink from the ground itself.

Wound with signal alloy and fitted with the contacts of a charge pad, the soles now take power from any machine you stand upon: a chassis offering its Power Terminal upward, a Frame Cell, any store of that artificial lightning.

Stand on a working machine, and walk away full.
research.thaumicboots.groundline.title: Groundline Striders
research.thaumicboots.lustral.stage_0:
Purifying fluid cleanses whoever bathes in it. Worked into the seasons boots, it cleanses whatever you walk upon.

Tainted soil, rock and wood around your steps return to what they were, and the air you stand in gives up its flux, a little every moment you wear them.

A slow cure, but a sure one.
research.thaumicboots.lustral.subtitle: A Bath for the Land
research.thaumicboots.lustral.title: Lustral Boots
research.thaumicboots.rift.stage_0:
The primordial boots carry the weight of the first things; the eldritch comet carries the cold of the void's own stars.

Joined on the lens, they no longer quite agree that the air cannot be stood upon. Leap, and leap again from nothing, twice before you must touch ground.

The rift remembers every step.
research.thaumicboots.rift.subtitle: Standing on Nothing
research.thaumicboots.rift.title: Primordial Boots of the Rift
research.thaumicboots.seasonal_boots.sta:
In your studies of magickal phenomena, you discovered something peculiar: there are spikes of magickal energies around specific parts of the solar calendar.

These spikes have been known to cause various transformations, such as transforming chests to presents, and vice versa as they pass. Interestingly, you've managed to capture this chaotic energy.

Yet you wonder if there is some way you may be able to stabilize these energies...
research.thaumicboots.seasonal_boots.sub: Christmas Spirits and Other Magickal Phenomena
research.thaumicboots.seasonal_stabilize:
As you continued your studies of the seasonal magick phenomena, you noticed something interesting, it actually is possible to attune these energies into a specific phenomena, resulting in a drastically boosted seasonal effect... with one caveat: these effects become incredibly diminished after the season has passed.

The first of these effects you've noticed is a drastic increase in the steady running speed over time, while freezing water similar to that of comet attuned magicks

Though, you almost swear you can hear sleigh bells...
You believe you should come back to this in December...
research.thaumicboots.sloth_sin.stage_0:
The Boots of the Sloth slowed their wearer, and you never learned why. The shards of the sin of sloth explain it: the sin wants a host.

Fed four shards, the boots stop slowing you and slow everything that hunts you instead. Monsters near you drag their feet and their claws.

You walk among them unhurried.
research.thaumicboots.sloth_sin.subtitle: The Sin Wants a Host
research.thaumicboots.sloth_sin.title: Boots of Slothful Sin
research.thaumicboots.spiritstep.stage_0:
The spirits of the otherworld walk unseen beside us. Silver, a spirit-attuned gem and otherworld essence teach a pair of traveller's boots to do the same.

Sneak a moment and you fade from sight; whatever was hunting you loses the trail.

Stand up, and the world sees you again.
research.thaumicboots.spiritstep.title: Spiritstep Boots
research.thaumicboots.tainted_core.stage:
Your study of your own mind and the void has yielded strange, new properties, previously thought impossible.

Speed unlike any other, even during flight, void empowered tendons allowing you to soar into the sky, you even saw a significant improvement in your innate ability to channel natural vis energies.

And yet, you feel as if there exists more potential past this...
With this understood, the combinations it opens up wait elsewhere in this book.
research.thaumicboots.tainted_core.subti: Void Thaumometry in the Human Psyche
research.thaumicboots.tainted_core.title: Void Magicks
research.thaumicboots.unique_boots.stage:
In your studies of magickal phenomena, you've run upon something peculiar: there are certain magicks that can only be recreated in exact scenarios. The first of these you've stumbled upon, being a seemingly simple slowness curse.

However, while you were able to reproduce the boots themselves, you cannot for the life of you understand how the magick energy works, nor how to recreate it directly.

You begin to wonder if you'll stumble upon energies in similar situations...
research.thaumicboots.unique_boots.title: Unique Magicks
research.thaumicboots.verdant.stage_0:
The seasons boots already remember spring. Bound with the leafguard of the Weedwarden's folk and spliced with both grafts, they now bring it.

Crops and saplings near your steps grow as if fed bone meal. Fierce herbs too, of course; and picked grown, they still wake what sleeps in them.

Walk your fields with care.
research.thaumicboots.verdant.subtitle: Spring in Every Step
research.thaumicboots.verdant.title: Verdant Boots
Explosions charge it; the charge feeds your slam
Briars catch your falls and root what is near
Crouch-jump at a frame wall to step through it
Land on mobs to stomp and wither them
Charges from the energy block you stand on
Cleanses taint underfoot and flux in the air
Sneak a moment to vanish from hunters
Crops and saplings grow where you walk
